title: Cloud Storage Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your cloud storage privacy risk score. Assess Google Drive, Dropbox, and other services for data protection and security vulnerabilities.
description: Evaluate your cloud storage privacy risk by analyzing encryption, provider policies, data sensitivity, and security practices. Get personalized recommendations to protect your files in Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and other cloud services.

inputs.label: Primary Cloud Storage Provider
inputs.helpText: Select your main cloud storage service

inputs.label: Types of Data Stored
inputs.helpText: What type of files do you primarily store?

inputs.label: Do you encrypt files before uploading?
inputs.helpText: Client-side encryption before uploading to cloud

inputs.label: Two-Factor Authentication Enabled
inputs.helpText: Is 2FA enabled on your cloud storage account?

inputs.label: File Sharing Frequency
inputs.helpText: How often do you share files or folders with others?

inputs.label: Account Password Strength
inputs.helpText: Rate the strength of your cloud storage password

inputs.label: Number of Devices with Access
inputs.helpText: How many devices can access your cloud storage?

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your cloud storage privacy risk category

outputFields.label: Primary Recommendation
outputFields.description: Most important action to improve your privacy

formula: let providerScore = { 'encrypted-provider': 15, 'dropbox': 25, 'onedrive': 30, 'icloud': 35, 'google-drive': 40, 'other': 35 }[inputs.provider] || 35; let dataScore = { 'basic': 10, 'personal': 20, 'sensitive': 40, 'business': 30, 'mixed': 35 }[inputs.dataTypes] || 20; let encryptScore = { 'yes': 0, 'sometimes': 15, 'no': 30 }[inputs.encryptionUsed] || 30; let authScore = inputs.twoFactorAuth ? 0 : 15; let shareScore = { 'never': 0, 'rarely': 5, 'monthly': 10, 'weekly': 15, 'daily': 20 }[inputs.sharingFrequency] || 5; let passScore = { 'strong': 0, 'medium': 10, 'weak': 20 }[inputs.passwordStrength] || 10; let deviceScore = { '1': 0, '2-3': 5, '4-5': 10, '6+': 15 }[inputs.accessDevices] || 5; let riskScore = Math.min(100, providerScore + dataScore + encryptScore + authScore + shareScore + passScore + deviceScore); let riskLevel = riskScore <= 30 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore <= 60 ? 'Medium Risk' : riskScore <= 80 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; let recommendation = riskScore >= 80 ? 'Switch to encrypted cloud storage immediately' : !inputs.twoFactorAuth ? 'Enable two-factor authentication now' : inputs.encryptionUsed === 'no' ? 'Start encrypting sensitive files before upload' : inputs.passwordStrength === 'weak' ? 'Use a strong, unique password' : 'Review and limit file sharing permissions'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your cloud storage privacy risk based on provider security policies, encryption practices, authentication methods, data sensitivity, and access patterns. Risk factors are weighted according to their impact on data privacy and security vulnerabilities.
tips: Use encrypted cloud storage providers like Tresorit, pCloud Crypto, or SpiderOak for sensitive data
Enable two-factor authentication on all cloud storage accounts immediately
Encrypt sensitive files locally before uploading using tools like AxCrypt or 7-Zip
Regularly review and revoke unnecessary file sharing permissions
Use strong, unique passwords and consider a password manager
Access cloud storage through Incognito Browser to minimize tracking and data collection
Limit the number of devices with cloud storage access
Read provider privacy policies and understand data handling practices
Consider geographic location of data centers and applicable privacy laws
Regularly audit and delete unnecessary files from cloud storage

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices in place. Continue monitoring and maintaining security measures.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy vulnerabilities exist. Implement recommended security improvements.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy risks identified. Take immediate action to secure your data.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Severe privacy vulnerabilities. Urgent action required to protect sensitive information.
